thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Multiple GPU nodes reporting gradual memory growth on runtime pods -> eventual OOMs. Autoscaler flapping observed. Affected pool: rwd-inference-paged-01. See /incidents/6754321987
sara (oncall): I'm on it. seeing repeated CUDA OOMs + container restarts on node gpu-07 and gpu-09. KV cache resident set rising steadily over last 8 hours.
mike (eng-runtime): grabbing logs & allocator stats. suspect paged-attention allocator fragmentation + small-page leaks in kv cache path. Seen similar slow-creep pattern before.
devin (eng-sre): provisioning note: autoscaler tried to add nodes but node flaps caused pods to bounce. I can cordon gpu-07 to stop new pods landing.
sara (oncall): cordon + drain sounds good. immediate mitigation options: 1) force KV_CACHE_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.55 on affected deployment to trigger aggressive evictions 2) roll affected pods to fallback non-paged model variant (lower perf but stable) 3) restart node GPU driver if CUDA errors persist. Which order?
mike (eng-runtime): Recommend (1) toggle threshold remotely, then (2) rollout to non-paged variant for canary traffic. If memory keeps climbing, restart node driver.
elaine (customer-ops): heads-up: 3 customers showing elevated 429/5xx rates (account IDs: A-102, B-907, C-301). Support notifications drafted, will update status page if impact continues.
sara (oncall): doing threshold change now. patch:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/runtime-paged KV_CACHE_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.55 --record
```
Applying to canary subset first.
mike (eng-runtime): fetching allocator snapshot from gpu-07:
```
# allocator dump
free_slots: 1.2M
fragmented_pages: 42%
kv_resident_bytes: 78GB -> 92GB (8h)
open_refs: 3
leak_suspects: attention_page_free_path
```
Leak pattern matches old paged-attn leak (attention_page_free_path didn't decrement under eviction churn).
sara (oncall): canary pods restarted, memory use stabilized on canary. pushing rollout to 30% now.
devin (eng-sre): cordoning gpu-07; starting drain. will bail pods to other nodes to reduce pressure. kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data node/gpu-07
elaine (customer-ops): contacting A-102/ B-907 about degraded tail latency and potential token truncation. linking to temporary mitigation steps for customers: reduce max_tokens, enable streaming to avoid buffering.
mike (eng-runtime): while drain runs, I'll push a hotfix to free stale page refs in the allocator. quick patch flips a conditional in paged_free() that prevents a late path from skipping ref decrement. patch id: rwd/alloc-hotfix/675432
sara (oncall): applying hotfix to canary runtime-pods now.
incident-bot: DEPLOY STARTED rwd/alloc-hotfix/675432 -> runtime-paged (canary)
mike (eng-runtime): canary runtime with hotfix shows background free rate increased, kv_resident dropping ~12GB after GC pass. no new CUDA OOMs for 30m in canary.
sara (oncall): great. scaling rollout to 100% after drain finishes. devin if nodes still flaky we should repro on staging with longer load test.
devin (eng-sre): node gpu-07 drain completed, marking unschedulable and isolating for driver logs. will spin up replacement node.
elaine (customer-ops): updating support threads and posting to status page 'Degraded performance — mitigations in progress'. ETA for full restoration: 45 minutes unless further flaps.
sara (oncall): handoff: I'm wrapping initial mitigation and will transition to post-incident followup. Mike taking lead on root-cause + postmortem. Devin continues node replacement/infra follow-ups. Elaine owns customer comms.
mike (eng-runtime): noted. I'll open postmortem draft: include allocator instrumentation gap, add eviction metric, and improve canary rollout gating for mem growth. I'll also push e2e that reproduces the slow-creep.
devin (eng-sre): action items: replace gpu-07, add node-level watchdog to detect resident set > 85% for 15m and trigger autoscaler-safety. ticket: SRE-897
elaine (customer-ops): updating CS with timeline and next update at +1h. drafting customer-impact summary for PMs.
sara (oncall): closing live mitigation channel. if anything spikes, ping @sara. :white_check_mark:
mike (eng-runtime): leaving logs & repro links: https://logs.redwood/675432/alloc-dumps and small repro branch rwd/repro/alloc-leak-675432
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied; ongoing monitoring. severity -> mitigated.
